scale.name: Not bootable
scale.meaning: A clean checkout can't install, build and pass its tests.

scale.name: Bootable
scale.meaning: A clean checkout installs, builds and passes every test.

scale.name: Verifiable
scale.meaning: Agents can check their own work: the commands pass, the tests catch planted faults, the instructions are accurate and normal work needs no production access.

scale.name: Delegable
scale.meaning: Agent PRs meet the outcome targets your team set, over at least 20 agent PRs in the window (never fewer than 10).

scale.name: Scalable
scale.meaning: Those targets held over two back-to-back windows while agent PR volume at least doubled.

maturity.rule: The repo level is the lowest level among active components, the assessed components with at least 10% of changes over 90 days; a component joins or leaves that set only after two audits on the same side of the line, except that one the last audit didn't have joins at once; when no assessed component reaches 10%, the largest sets it; and components the audit can't assess never set it.

actions.title: Set up the service the tests expect on port 5432 for agents in api
actions.why: In a clean container, api's tests fail because nothing starts the service the tests expect on port 5432: the connection was refused.
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes api to Level 1, covering 56% of recent changes. Agents can run api's checks before they push, so fewer agent PRs fail CI the first time.
actions.watch: Share of agent PRs touching api that pass CI the first time. Now: 20% (1 of 5), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.
actions.research: In the BootstrapAgent study, a reusable, verified setup cut later agents' token use by 25.9% and build time by 22.3%. Measured on the study's benchmark repositories. https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15815
actions.effortAndOwner: Small: setup scripts and environment config, no source changes. Repo maintainer.

actions.title: Fix the stale agent instructions
actions.why: 3 instructions agents would follow are wrong: npm run changelog (no "changelog" script in package.json), pnpm test (uses pnpm, but the repo uses npm).
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes shared to Level 2, covering 15% of recent changes. Agents stop following stale steps, such as running pnpm in a repo that doesn't use it.
actions.watch: Agent PRs that add a stray pnpm-lock.yaml. Now: 11% (1 of 9), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.

actions.title: Make worker's tests catch wrong behavior
actions.why: The audit planted 5 faults in worker in a throwaway copy, and the tests caught 0.
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes shared to Level 2, worker to Level 2 together with Fix the stale agent instructions. Changes in worker get a real pass-or-fail signal, so reviewers catch less by hand.
actions.watch: Share of agent PRs touching worker where a reviewer requested changes. Now: 2 of 3 (too few for a rate), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.
actions.research: OpenAI estimated about 30% of SWE-Bench Pro's 731 public tasks were broken, including low-coverage tests that let incomplete fixes pass. An audit of one benchmark, not of customer repositories. https://openai.com/index/separating-signal-from-noise-coding-evaluations
actions.effortAndOwner: Medium: tests in worker only. Component owner.
actions.decision: What the untested behavior in packages/worker/src/retry.js should be
actions.doneWhen: A new audit's fresh planted faults in worker are all caught.

steps.title: Set up the service the tests expect on port 5432 for agents in api
Ask the agent to fix it
steps.detail: Say "fix the primary blocker". It drafts install and start scripts and a `.cursor/environment.json` with `readiness draft-env`.

steps.title: The agent proves it
steps.detail: `readiness replay --component api` must pass every test before the fix is offered.

steps.title: Review and merge
steps.detail: Check that the start script only starts local services and names no production URLs.

steps.title: Point Cloud Agents at it
steps.detail: A team admin sets the Cloud Agent environment to read `.cursor/environment.json`; committing the file alone changes no environment.

steps.title: Re-audit
steps.detail: The next audit confirms Level 1 and can now plant faults in api.

steps.title: Fix each listed item
steps.detail: `.cursor/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:8` `npm run changelog`: no "changelog" script in package.json; `AGENTS.md:7` `pnpm test`: uses pnpm, but the repo uses npm; `AGENTS.md:8` `docs/architecture.md`: docs/architecture.md doesn't exist

steps.title: Prove it
steps.detail: `readiness run --instructions` replays every command and checks every path.

steps.title: Make worker's tests catch wrong behavior
Decide the intended behavior
steps.detail: For the files named here, write down what correct behavior is, including edge cases.

steps.title: Write tests that pin it down
steps.detail: Assert results and edge cases, not just that code runs.

steps.title: Prove it with fresh faults
steps.detail: Run a new audit. It plants different faults than this one, so tests aimed at one audit's faults don't help.

steps.title: Review
steps.detail: `readiness diff` flags any deleted test or new skip marker, so nothing was weakened to pass.
